what: Installation weeks, VERTICAL pair: ≥ 3 nights of cosmics with the full trigger. Measures the arm-to-arm time of flight (σ_t), each arm's MIP gain and the rejection of every cosmic veto, in the worst geometry

Roll to the HORIZONTAL pair. Beam on target at low current; target conditioning; current scan 0.05 → 1 µA: trigger rates, DREAM live time, Micromegas occupancy, SiPM/plastic singles; γ-yield reference

H₂⁺ at 0.883 MV (two 0.441 MeV protons), IF the CN can provide it: 17.64 MeV M1 IPC, absolute rate, opening-angle shape and energy scale against Geant4 (~47 selected pairs per working day, 141 per day of beam). Without H₂⁺ these days are not requested
18.15 MeV region: IPC spectrum, X17 window (15 working days = 5 days of beam); γ-yield check each day
Arms ADJACENT (90°): small-angle IPC and external conversions (~500 pairs in 8 h)
